- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of common skin types and tips on how to cater to each type in the stream.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant created a list of common skin types:
  - Normal Skin: Balanced skin, recommend gentle products.
  - Dry Skin: Tight, flaky skin, recommend hydrating products.
  - Oily Skin: Shiny skin, recommend oil-free products.
  - Combination Skin: Oily in T-zone, recommend balanced products.
  - Sensitive Skin: Easily irritated skin, recommend gentle products.
  - Acne-Prone Skin: Frequent breakouts, recommend salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide.
  - Mature Skin: Signs of aging, recommend antioxidants
